qaNotes: CSV parsing is implemented without external libraries so imported file contents remain local.

Export uses UTF-8 BOM to improve compatibility with Japanese Excel workflows.
No network API is used for CSV contents.
Final Microsoft package generation must use the actual Partner Center Package ID, Publisher display name and Publisher ID.
